user.title: Usage Instructions
user.description:
### Please confirm the following information:
1. You have fully read and accepted the **Disclaimer** on the project homepage.
2. You have fully read the **Usage Instructions** on the project homepage.
3. You have fully read the **detailed configuration and usage guide**.
4. You have obtained the Device ID through the **SMS Fire Rite**.

data.accept_terms: I confirm the above information and willingly accept all causal outcomes of the simulation.

account.title: CTC Account Configuration
account.description:
### Notes:
- Please enter your account identifier, access password, and Device ID.
- The system uses persistent credentials for silent synchronization to ensure stability.
- Supports multiple accounts, up to 3 accounts.
- Multiple account additions may have a delay, please be patient.

reconfigure.title: Update CTC Access Credentials
reconfigure.description: Your access credentials have expired or the connection has been interrupted. Please update your access password or Device ID.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Credentials for account {phonenum} have expired. Please update the password or Device ID.

error.terms_not_accepted: Please confirm the usage instructions first
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the server or the account is temporarily restricted
error.login_cooldown: Security protection: too many attempts, please try again in 10 minutes
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, please check the password or device ID
error.need_captcha: Security verification triggered! Please log in once via the official mobile app to lift the restriction.
error.reconfigure_failed: Failed to update credentials, please check the password or device ID

abort.max_accounts_reached: Account limit reached (max 3 accounts). Please remove extra accounts and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the server. Please try again later.
